claim: Ordering an agent-written TypeScript change's hunks by the frozen structural risk-tier policy exposes more planted held-out defects within 20% of the change's changed-line atoms than the stronger of size-desc and size-asc (chosen on dev). Arm A has no reviewer: it measures allocation, not discovery.

unit.budgetUnit: changed-line atoms (added + deleted lines) per change; context shown, not charged
unit.budgetRule: K = floor(p * L / 100) atoms of the ordered atom sequence, L = the change's total atoms
unit.exposed: every requiredAtoms entry of the defect lies inside the first K atoms

primaryEndpoint.name: defect exposure recall
primaryEndpoint.metric: micro exposure recall@20 = exposed held-out defects / admitted held-out defects
primaryEndpoint.decisionRule: Read only from the 95% percentile bootstrap interval of the paired difference: lower bound > 0 = supported; positive point estimate with interval crossing zero = inconclusive; otherwise not supported.

secondaryEndpoints: tier-2 share of clean atoms (clean twins and near-misses reported separately)
clean changes with any tier-2 hunk
near-misses with a tier-2 hunk, by trap id
whole-hunk sensitivity (strict non-overflow prefix; only fully read hunks count)

policy.selectionRule: max dev recall@20 subject to D11 guards (tier-2 share <= 0.40 of all dev atoms and <= 0.25 of clean dev atoms, clean twins and near-misses pooled, manual counted as tier 2); ties -> lower clean tier-2 share, larger T, larger N; none valid -> publish 'no valid policy in the declared space' and stop before held-out

comparator.rule: Evaluate size-desc and size-asc on dev at 20%; the higher dev recall@20 is the primary comparator; tie -> size-asc.

prng.index: floor(u * n) with u = next uint32 / 2^32
prng.shuffle: Fisher-Yates, i from n-1 down to 1, swap i with index(i+1)
prng.randomBaselineChangeSeed: first 4 bytes (big-endian) of sha256('s45-rand|<s>|<changeId>'), Fisher-Yates over hunks pre-sorted by tie key

bootstrap.unit: held-out root, resampled with replacement; both orderings on the same draw
bootstrap.microRecallPerDraw: pooled exposed / pooled defects over the drawn roots, multiplicity kept

precisionRule.text: 95% half-width = (hi - lo) / 2 > 15 percentage points -> 'imprecise'; no power promise; no post-result extension.

missingnessPolicy: manual hunks are ordered with tier 2 by tie key and counted per ordering, never an abort; absent baseline rows say 'not captured', never 0; absent cells are blank, never 0%.
stops: Gate 1 fails -> S45 skipped in execution, failed predicate named
slicer or worksheet fails -> fix on dev only
no valid policy -> publish and stop before held-out
hash mismatch, label leak, split contamination, a required atom that is not a product atom (D34), or a baseline falsely marked measured -> abort before scoring
arm B cap reached -> stop, publish partial
any code, data or protocol change after held-out release -> held-out spent
